categories.main_business_segments: Shanghai Wafer Works Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor silicon epitaxial wafers. The company specializes in integrated manufacturing processes from crystal growth, substrate forming to epitaxial growth, producing high-quality silicon epitaxial wafers mainly used in power devices and analog chips across automotive, industrial, communication, and office sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company possesses core technologies including magnetic field Czochralski crystal growth, multi-element doping, defect control, ultra-low resistivity crystal growth, single-wafer polishing, surface cleanliness treatment, nano-morphology control, and advanced epitaxial growth techniques such as buried layer epitaxy and thick epitaxy. It employs integrated production methods combining crystal growth, substrate processing, and epitaxial growth, supported by intelligent manufacturing systems like SAP, MES, and SPC for quality control and process optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading global semiconductor foundries and IDM manufacturers such as TSMC, Hua Hong Group, On Semiconductor, Texas Instruments, STMicroelectronics, and Analog Devices. The end markets served are automotive, industrial, communications, and office electronics, with products used in power devices (IGBT, MOSFET), analog chips (PMIC), and image sensors (CIS).
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shanghai, Zhengzhou, and Yangzhou. Its customer base spans North America, Europe, Taiwan, and other Asian regions, reflecting a broad international market presence.
categories.supply_chain_position: Shanghai Wafer Works operates upstream in the semiconductor supply chain as a manufacturer of silicon epitaxial wafers, a critical raw material for semiconductor chip fabrication. It supplies wafers to downstream chip manufacturers including foundries and IDM companies.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on advancing 12-inch large-diameter silicon wafer technology, expanding production capacity, and enhancing high-end domestic substitution in power device epitaxial wafers. R&D priorities include developing 12-inch 55nm CIS epitaxial wafers, 28nm P/P- epitaxial wafers, and automotive-grade IGBT wafers. It emphasizes differentiated competition, cost reduction, and efficiency improvements while continuously investing in core technology innovation and patent development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of semiconductor silicon epitaxial wafers. The company employs a make-to-order production model with direct sales and distributor channels, selling wafers to semiconductor foundries and IDM manufacturers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global semiconductor silicon wafer market is dominated by international leaders such as Shin-Etsu Chemical, Sumco, GlobalWafers, Siltronic, and SK Siltron. Shanghai Wafer Works is one of the few Chinese companies with integrated epitaxial wafer production capabilities, steadily increasing its market share and recognized by major international customers as a reliable supplier, positioning itself as a leading domestic player in the silicon epitaxial wafer segment.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.11 billion, a 17.76% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 120.78 million, down 51.07%. Total assets grew 24.44% to RMB 4.57 billion, and net assets increased 48.49% to RMB 4.14 billion, mainly due to successful IPO fundraising. The company continues to invest heavily in R&D, with expenditures accounting for over 9% of revenue.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Shanghai Wafer Works offers high-quality, customized silicon epitaxial wafers with superior flatness, uniformity, and low defect density, leveraging its integrated production process for enhanced quality control. Its advanced technologies and patented processes enable it to meet stringent specifications required by leading semiconductor manufacturers, supporting domestic substitution and reducing reliance on imports. The company emphasizes differentiated competition through innovation, quality, and customer service to maintain a competitive edge.
